meta.title: Nexrive - Technology for people who live their cars
meta.description: Nexrive builds connected apps for car owners and enthusiasts: Volta for maintenance, Avanti for community and Meetings for events.

hero.lead: Nexrive builds apps that connect with each other to follow the whole life of a vehicle: its maintenance, its history, its community and its meetups.
hero.fact2_label: app already published on Google Play
hero.fact3_label: where Nexrive is born and built

products.title: Three apps, one vehicle
products.lead: Each product solves a specific problem on its own and gains value when used alongside the others.

volta.name: Nexrive Volta
volta.tagline: Your car, always up to date
volta.body: The copilot that brings expenses, maintenance, documents and reminders together so driving becomes more predictable.
volta.f3: A tidy history that backs the value of the vehicle

avanti.name: Nexrive Avanti
avanti.tagline: The social network where the car is the star
avanti.body: A place to show builds, document modifications and find people who share the same car culture.
avanti.f1: A dedicated profile for each vehicle and its modifications
avanti.f2: A build card ready to share
avanti.f3: A community organized by styles and interests

meetings.name: Nexrive Meetings
meetings.body: The simple way to discover, organize and remember car events, from a local meetup to a full show.
meetings.f3: Photos of the meet in one place

ecosystem.title: Each app feeds the others
ecosystem.lead: The Nexrive vision is a single account that gathers what today lives scattered across notebooks, chats and general social networks.
ecosystem.c1_body: Maintenance logged in Volta backs the vehicle profile in the community with a verifiable history.
ecosystem.c2_body: From a build profile you can call or join a meet with the people who already follow it.
ecosystem.c3_body: What happens at an event returns to the vehicle record: the trip, the kilometers and the photos of the day.
ecosystem.note: These connections describe the product direction and will go live as Avanti and Meetings are released.

roadmap.title: Where we are heading
roadmap.s1_body: The vehicle management app is published on Google Play for Chile and receives continuous improvements.
roadmap.s2_body: Early access with a founding group of enthusiasts before opening the community to the public.
roadmap.s3_body: Events join the ecosystem and connect with the profiles and history of each vehicle.
roadmap.s4_body: We are exploring parts with guaranteed fitment, assisted diagnostics and forums by make and model.

principles.title: How we build
principles.p1_body: Our products revolve around the vehicle and its story, not the popularity of whoever drives it.
principles.p2_body: Each app must solve a real problem on its own, even offline and without depending on the others.
principles.p3_body: A tidy, verifiable record makes the vehicle easier to maintain and backs it when it is time to sell.
principles.p4_body: We prefer a small group of passionate people over a large number of unused downloads.

company.title: An independent automotive software studio
company.p1: Nexrive is a Chilean project founded by Giulianno Inostroza. It designs, develops and operates its own products from end to end.
company.p2: We work with cross-platform technology and cloud services so a small team can deliver careful, secure and sustainable apps.

contact.title: Let's talk
contact.lead: For support, partnerships with workshops or communities, and questions about the products, reach us through the support center.
